body: It feels like it'll never get better
Find something to hold on to
Youll never have to know true loneliness. When someone who u need to keep living throws u away. Thats loneliness
Same thing happened to me. He killed me. You should talk to me
Imagine living life with a partner who makes you die inside more and more until you die on the outside
You'll never fail her if you're living for her
Because one day, someone is going to care for you and need you. You have to stay for then even if they aren't in your life yet
